caseName: Riverbank Laboratories v. Hardwood Products Corp.
caseNameFull: Riverbank Laboratories v. Hardwood Products Corp.

opinions.text: Certiorari, 350 U. S. 817, to the United States Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit. The order entered in this case on April 2, 1956, ante, p. 1003, is amended to provide for a remand of the case to the United States Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit.
